title: 1-order-calculator.html
description: Calculate cake costs instantly with this interactive pricing tool. Input ingredients, layers, fillings, and decorations to generate accurate quotes for custom orders.

title: 2-recipes-and-pricing.html
description: Calculate ingredient costs, portion pricing, and profit margins for cakes, fillings, and pastries. Interactive recipe costing tool for bakers and cake businesses.

title: 3-production-sheet.html
description: Interactive production sheet for bakeries. Calculate ingredients, plan bake sequences, and generate shopping lists for multi-tier cakes and custom orders with real-time inventory tracking.

title: 4-batter-calibration.html
description: Calculate cake batter density, estimate ingredient costs, and generate production sheets. Interactive tool for bakeries to price orders and manage recipes accurately.

title: 5-recipe-job-tags.html
description: Interactive recipe calculator that tracks ingredient costs, batch yields, and tags recipes by usage (filling, crumb coat, covering). Perfect for bakers and cake decorators.

title: 6-stock-adjustment.html
description: Track stock adjustments, record inventory losses, and view detailed movement reports. Manage spoilage, damage, and counting discrepancies with real-time cost calculations.
